entries.title: II Chronicles 30:1
segments: The true friends of God are exceedingly desirous that all, brethren and strangers, friends and foes, should unite in worshipping him and attending, according to his requirements, on his ordinances.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:2
segments: To keep the passover in the second month; in accordance with the provision of the law,

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:5
segments: As it was written; written and required in the law of Moses.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:6
segments: Kings of Assyria; Pul and Tiglath-pileser.  Hezekiah came to the throne in the reign of Hoshea the last king of Israel,

, when the Assyrians had already wasted the kingdom of Israel and carried captive many of its inhabitants, and were preparing to make its overthrow complete. 
 
If those who are suffering for their sins heartily for sake them and turn unto the Lord, he will have mercy upon them, turn from the fierceness of his anger, and do them good according to the riches of his grace.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:10
segments: When the offers of mercy are made to men, some treat them with scorn and contempt; others who feel their need of mercy, joyfully accept them, humble themselves before God, and devote their bodies and souls to his service.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:14
segments: The altars; idolatrous altars which they had caused to be erected.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:15
segments: Were ashamed; to see the people go before them in the good work of reformation.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:17
segments: Not sanctified; by the performance of those ceremonies which were required by the law of Moses.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:18
segments: The proper preparation of the heart is more important in the sight of God, when attending on his ordinances, than any mere outward observance; and inability to attend on what is external, should not lead to the neglect of the heart.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:20
segments: Healed the people; pardoned and accepted them, because they were sincere in his service, notwithstanding their ceremonial uncleanness.

entries.title: II Chronicles 30:22
segments: They who attend on ordinances sincerely and are accepted of God, nevertheless need further instruction as to his character and will; and ministers should continue to give such instruction, that their hearers may understand the whole will of God.
